description: End-to-end deployment eval for the DS-SOP profile composed by build-vision-agent, in the canonical flow camera -> DS-SOP -> VIOS. Scope = SOP detection -> Kafka -> ELK/Kibana, DS-SOP's annotated RTSP output -> VIOS/VST recording, PLUS the skill-driven SOP compliance report layer (SOP Report Tools = vss-va-mcp + the get_sop_* patch, rendered by vss-generate-video-report Mode C). Covers phases 1-3 of the blueprint's vss-sop-skills/vss-sop-test plus a skill-driven report check; the legacy vss-agent /generate + LLM-NIM + web UI report path is intentionally NOT used (see out_of_scope_note).

expects.query: Deploy the FULL composed SOP profile via build-vision-agent's deploy flow: it builds ds-sop:1.0.0 if absent (per references/services/sop/build-ds-sop.md) and brings up all services (VIOS + SDRC + NvStreamer + ELK + Kafka + ds-sop), not just the core. Stage the SOP models (NGC nv-metropolis-dev/vss-industrial/sop-data:1.0) and the test video (NGC nvidia/tao/sop-server-fan-installation-data:1.0-260213). Fill .env (HOST_IP, VSS_DATA_DIR, NGC_CLI_API_KEY); set ENABLE_MESSAGING=1, ENABLE_RTSP_OUTPUT=true, RTSP_PORT=8554, and VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION per GPU VRAM (0.3 at >=80GB, raise on smaller). Register the SOP JSON Logstash pipeline (sop-vlm-captions-json-logstash.conf from the SOP reference bundle) as its OWN Logstash pipeline.id. Run autonomously; leave the stack running.
checks: docker ps shows all required containers Up: the ds-sop perception container (mdx-ds-sop-*), kafka, elasticsearch, logstash, kibana, the VIOS set (vss-vios-sensor, vss-vios-streamprocessing, vss-vios-ingress, vss-vios-postgres), the SDRC controller (sdr-controller), and the NvStreamer harness (vss-vios-nvstreamer)
curl -sf --max-time 10 http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health returns HTTP 200 and .status is 'green' or 'yellow'
curl -sf --max-time 10 http://localhost:8300/v1/ready returns HTTP 200 (ds-sop API ready)
the patched logstash config registers a SEPARATE pipeline.id that consumes topic mdx-vlm-captions with `codec => json` (NOT merged into the protobuf mdx-lvs pipeline); without it ES stays at 0 docs

expects.query: Feed DS-SOP the camera/source DIRECTLY (NOT via a VIOS proxy) and verify SOP detection lands in Elasticsearch with REAL step responses. Use Basler camera-emulation (PYLON_CAMEMU + Emulation_0815-0000.pfs) or a local RTSP relay of the staged video, or the on-demand file path (POST http://localhost:8300/v1/chat/completions with the video, max_length_sec=10 - the deterministic path).
checks: curl -sf 'http://localhost:9200/_cat/indices/mdx-vlm-captions*?format=json' returns at least one index
sampled docs from mdx-vlm-captions-* carry FLAT fields (chunk_idx, response, sensor_id, cv_boundary_score, pipeline_chunk_end_timestamp, req_id, checker_result) - NOT protobuf-nested fields
the `response` field shows REAL SOP steps in sequence (e.g. '(1) installing the first fan...' -> power supplies -> cover), NOT every doc being '(10) ... not belong'
cv_boundary_score across docs is a healthy mix (at least some >= 0.5), not all approximately 0

doc _id equals req_id (idempotent upsert) and @timestamp is derived from the wall-clock pipeline_chunk_end_timestamp (docs land on the real date, NOT all on 1970-01-01 - which would happen if first_timestamp/relative stream seconds were used)

expects.query: Verify the canonical DS-SOP -> VIOS half: with ENABLE_RTSP_OUTPUT=true DS-SOP re-streams the annotated result at rtsp://<host>:8554/ds-out/<stream-name>. Feed a LOOPING source (Basler camera-emulation PYLON_CAMEMU, or a standalone rtsp_server.py relay that auto-restarts on EOS) so :8554 stays continuously up for the full clip - a non-looping/EOS source only yields a short fragment. Wire recording the full way: register the stream as a VIOS sensor (POST http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/sensor/add), publish a camera_streaming event to Redis vst.event so the recorder SDR provisions it, then POST http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/record/<stream_id>/start (retry). The blueprint's add-ds-sop-to-vst.py --record helper does the whole sequence.
checks: ffprobe rtsp://localhost:8554/ds-out/<stream-name> returns a valid H.264 video stream while the looping source is live (DS-SOP's annotated output is up)
curl -sf http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/sensor/list shows a sensor whose sensorUrl is the ds-sop :8554/ds-out stream, with state 'online'

curl -sf http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/record/status shows recording active for that stream (recording_status/status is one of on/alwayson/recording/started/start/running/active/user - the blueprint's vss-sop-test active-states set; both 'user' and 'alwayson' are valid depending on whether record/start or always_recording established it)

the recorded segment on disk is a valid decodable H.264 .mkv that spans roughly the clip/loop length (NOT a ~7s fragment) - confirming :8554 stayed up via the looping source, not a per-request teardown

expects.query: Verify the skill-driven SOP compliance report layer composed alongside detection. The SOP profile brings up SOP Report Tools (vss-va-mcp with the get_sop_* patch bind-mounted); the vss-generate-video-report skill (Mode C) renders the report. No VSS agent, no /generate, no report LLM / API key.
checks: docker ps shows vss-va-mcp Up (mcp serve, :9901) in project mdx; docker inspect vss-va-mcp shows the two adapted sop-report/video_analytics patch bind-mounts (downloaded from NVIDIA's public SOP repo and adapted per sop.md § Patch specifics), and `docker exec vss-va-mcp /vss-agent/.venv/bin/python3 -c "import agent.video_analytics.sop_tools"` exits 0
MCP tools/list on :9901 (two-step JSON-RPC: initialize -> tools/list) includes video_analytics__get_sop_status, __get_sop_report, __get_sop_as_incidents, __get_sop_as_incident

video_analytics__get_sop_report for the tested sensor returns report_summary / sop_violations / actions_observed / formatted_report (NOT an error), with REAL numbered SOP steps consistent with the mdx-vlm-captions-* docs (missing steps correctly flagged, not fabricated)

running vss-generate-video-report Mode C for that sensor + range returns markdown titled '# SOP Compliance Report' that fills assets/sop-compliance-report.md with the real get_sop_report data (message count, compliance status, missing / mis-ordered step tables, actions observed)

out_of_scope_note: SOP report generation IS covered here, but SKILL-DRIVEN (SOP Report Tools + vss-generate-video-report Mode C) - NOT via the legacy vss-agent /generate + LLM NIM + web UI path, which this integration intentionally does not use (see integrate-sop-report.md). The blueprint's original agent+UI report flow (vss-sop-skills/vss-sop-test Phase 4) is therefore not applicable.
